# Ajay Thorat

He builds production-ready, scalable web applications and currently works as a Junior Full Stack Developer at ICT Mumbai Research Foundation (Mumbai Biocluster).

## Experience

- Junior Full Stack Developer at ICT Mumbai Research Foundation (Mumbai Biocluster) (18 May 2026 - Present) — current role at a Section-8 nonprofit biotech research facility at ICT Mumbai. Sole full-stack developer of three production platforms: IndiaPharmaHub (a B2B pharma and biopharma outsourcing marketplace), Yantra (a lab instrument booking and sample testing marketplace), and an internal HRMS, built with Next.js 16, TypeScript, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Redis, NextAuth v5, Razorpay, and AWS.
- Junior Full Stack Developer at Renewalytics Services Pvt. Ltd. (18 March 2025 - 09 March 2026) — built full-stack applications for AI-powered renewable energy forecasting and grid management using Next.js, Prisma, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, BullMQ, and Highcharts.
- Full-Stack Developer Intern at ShypBUDDY PVT. LTD (March 2024 - September 2024) — built e-commerce shipping platform features using Next.js, Supabase, Prisma, Clerk, and Tailwind CSS.

## Events

- PCG 2026, the Peptides & Complex Generics Symposium (28–29 September 2026, Aurika by Lemon Tree Hotels, Mumbai), organized by Mumbai Biocluster and ICT Mumbai, with 400+ delegates and 70+ speakers. Ajay was part of the Mumbai Biocluster team running the event: he managed speaker travel and gathered feedback on IndiaPharmaHub and Yantra directly from speakers and industry leaders.
